## Scope

Describe the user-visible outcome and link the tracking issue.

## Evidence and validation

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`, the operating runbook, and task-relevant maintained docs/skills.
- [ ] Automated checks are listed with the exact source SHA and results; skipped checks have a reason.
- [ ] Documentation, status, capability, or release evidence is updated where facts changed.
- [ ] Hardware claims are tied to the exact candidate and evidence; physical actions were authorized and restoration verified where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private reports, raw owner data, local backups, or unrelated files are included.
- [ ] Application package/version/signing/release configuration changes are explicitly called out.

## Known limits and approvals

List unresolved failures, evidence limits, follow-up work, and any remaining owner approval. A passing build does not imply physical qualification, merge approval, or release authorization.
